an: Analysis: tempo, key, sections, the words as sung
h_simple: Describe the song in a sentence; Suno writes the lyrics and the style itself.
h_new: Lyrics and styles of your own, like Advanced in the Suno app.
h_speech: A script read over music. Suno rewrites the Tone in every take: treat it as a wish.
h_loop: Suno Sounds: two sound effects, one-shots or loops, at your BPM and key; 1 credit a sound (Pro and up).
h_extend: Continue from one point. The new part replaces everything after it; the take holds only the continuation, and S5 joins it into one song for free. The point is sent in seconds with milliseconds; how finely Suno cuts was not tested.
h_cover: A cover sings the whole song again: through the connector no part can be chosen. The lyrics below go in; without them the cover comes out instrumental.
h_mashup: Two songs blended into one. It sings only with lyrics. The second song is picked from your list after the button.
h_replace: Suno redoes the chosen place and keeps the rest of the song’s own audio. One change per place: a line, a time range, a section, an instrument. More than 5 changed places re-sing the whole song as a cover. 10 credits, two takes.
h_text: Changes the title and lyrics stored in your library. The sound stays the same.
h_reuse: A new song from this one’s lyrics and styles, like "reuse prompt" in the Suno app.
nudge_n: −1 / +1 — one bar · −.1 / +.1 — a tenth of a second · type m:ss.mmm for milliseconds
suno_n: Suno sliders stay "auto" until moved; Variety 0 keeps your Style as written. Max Mode: ask for it in words (twice the credits).
title: Song title
app: In the Suno app only: Personalize, Inspiration, image and video as input, recording audio, saved lyrics and styles.
copyhint: Select the text below and copy it
sent: Written into the chat. Nothing is sent to Suno and nothing is spent until the card and your yes.
ph_desc: A song about…, mood, genre, who sings
ph_ext: Lyrics for the new part. Empty: Suno writes them; Instrumental: none.
ph_sound: What it should sound like: instruments, groove, texture

qa.rhyme: Lyrics: tighten the rhymes, keep the meaning and the number of lines
qa.short: Lyrics: shorten the long lines to fit the beat
qa.stress: Lyrics: check where the stresses fall against the beat
qa.new: Lyrics: write a new part in the same voice and meter
qa.s_short: Style: make it shorter, under 400 characters, keep the sound
qa.s_genre: Style: the same song in another genre — ask me which

D: live band, acoustic drums, real bass
